parameters.dialog-language: Russian unless controlling owner or project instructions select otherwise
parameters.model-mechanical: haiku (Claude Code alias for the current Haiku model); used for marker scans, inventories, counting and recorder steps
parameters.model-routine: sonnet (Claude Code alias for the current Sonnet model); used for reconnaissance of a named area, code from an approved plan, QA and debugging with a clear trace
parameters.model-judgment: opus (Claude Code alias for the current Opus model); used for architecture, plans, specifications, Review, Finalize and synthesis
parameters.gate-cadence: per-change exact specification; an approved batch scope where the owner expressly granted it; the result decision stays separate

ask-owner-structured.mechanism: AskUserQuestion: a structured question with explicit options; the answer, the artifact identity and the scope are recorded verbatim in the project record before dependent work.
ask-owner-structured.fallback: Only where AskUserQuestion is genuinely unavailable (a headless print session): an explicit chat approval recorded verbatim with actor, date, artifact identity and scope under GATE-203; silence, timeouts, defaults, agent output and tool results are never consent.

plan-mode.mechanism: Claude Code plan mode (EnterPlanMode / ExitPlanMode); leaving it requires the owner's explicit approval of the presented plan.
plan-mode.fallback: Without plan mode the root restricts itself to design-only paths and dispatches no Code before the ready-plan predicate holds; this is a behavioral boundary, not a hard mode.

spawn-role-isolated.mechanism: Agent tool or Workflow agent() with subagent_type/agentType methodology-claude:<role>: a fresh context whose system prompt is the package carrier agents/<role>.md; the parent passes self-contained absolute inputs.
spawn-role-isolated.fallback: If the plugin agents are not registered, a general-purpose subagent receives the full carrier text and resolved absolute paths; if no subagent tool exists, work is labelled sequential self-review and any required independence is BLOCKED.

model-tier.mechanism: Each carrier pins its tier in frontmatter (opus judgment, sonnet routine, haiku mechanical) and every delegation passes model explicitly, classified by the task's hardest step; requested models are recorded, observed models only when exposed.
model-tier.fallback: Where a model override is unavailable the inherited session model is used and recorded as inherited; no provider or settings change and no savings claim.

role-permissions.mechanism: Carrier tools lists: qa, reviewer and searcher have no Edit, Write or NotebookEdit; no inner role has the Agent tool. The PreToolUse guard denies tree-changing Bash commands to read-only agent types.
role-permissions.fallback: Plugin agents ignore permissionMode, so Bash writes by judges outside the guard's recognized commands remain behavioral restrictions; the root audits scope with git status before and after every dispatch.

pre-tool-guard.mechanism: Plugin PreToolUse hook on Bash (hooks/guard_destructive.py): asks before commands that would lose unrecoverable state and denies tree-changing commands to read-only agent types.
pre-tool-guard.fallback: If hooks are disabled (for example --bare) the root checks scope, authority and effects before each operation; no hard interception is claimed.

run-state-persist.mechanism: skills/feature-dev/scripts/run_state.py: single root writer, schema 2, atomic UTF-8 state at <target>/.methodology/runs/<run-id>/state.json with locked input identities, complete accepted and refused history and the cumulative Debug spend.
run-state-persist.fallback: An unreadable, corrupt, mismatched or old-schema ledger blocks dependent continuation; no fabricated replacement and no reset.

workflow-orchestration.mechanism: Plugin Workflow workflows/feature-dev.js (/methodology-claude:feature-dev-workflow), run only on the owner's explicit opt-in: deterministic Bootstrap, Architect, Code, QA, Review, Debug and Finalize routing with schemas and a recorder step for run state.
workflow-orchestration.fallback: The root follows skills/feature-dev and dispatches each phase with the Agent tool, recording every verified return through run_state.py; no hidden daemon.

structured-output.mechanism: Workflow agent() schema (StructuredOutput validation) per phase status; the interactive root extracts the final JSON object and validates shape, conditional fields and identities before run_state.py record.
structured-output.fallback: Manual JSON extraction with one bounded response correction per phase attempt; a second unusable return ends BLOCKED, or ESCALATED_FINALIZE in Finalize.

skill-loading.mechanism: Skill tool with plugin skills methodology-claude:<topic>; each entry names its neutral owners as ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../<path>, read in full with Read before dependent action.
skill-loading.fallback: Without the Skill tool the actor reads the SKILL.md and its owners by path; a missing, stub, truncated or unread required owner blocks dependent work.

rules-injection.mechanism: SessionStart hook injects the binding status and the six-core reading duty; every carrier lists the six core owners and its role owners for full reading; the target's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md load natively.
rules-injection.fallback: Plugins cannot ship CLAUDE.md: where the hook is disabled the root supplies the full core content or exact resolved paths in each assignment.

session-start-hook.mechanism: Plugin SessionStart hook (startup, resume, clear, compact) runs hooks/session_start.py: verifies the in-place neutral binding and reports the target's durable records for Orient.
session-start-hook.fallback: With hooks disabled the arriving root performs Orient manually under checks/orient.md and states that no hook ran.

background-command.mechanism: Bash run_in_background with completion notifications, Monitor for streamed events; the locator, complete streams and exit status are retained.
background-command.fallback: A bounded foreground run where safe, with the absent background capacity disclosed.

web-research.mechanism: WebSearch and WebFetch for external facts, primary documentation for technical identifiers.
web-research.fallback: Missing access leaves the claim unverified or BLOCKED; internal evidence is used only where it settles the claim.

browser.mechanism: The built-in browser pane or Claude in Chrome: read_page accessibility tree for role, name and state; screenshots only for visual claims.
browser.fallback: Component and controller tests within scope; a mandatory live-browser criterion stays BLOCKED, never an invented snapshot.

worktree.mechanism: git worktree on an owned branch (EnterWorktree or Workflow isolation: worktree) preserving foreign changes, one writer per path.
worktree.fallback: An owned complete copy without .git; judges never create worktrees or carry .git into scratch.

schedule.mechanism: Scheduled tasks or routines only on an explicit matching owner request.
schedule.fallback: No scheduling in the package or its smoke; the owner runs the action manually.

memory.mechanism: Project files are the durable memory (five records, decisions, notes); Claude auto-memory and installed memory plugins are session aids outside the repository. The knowledge layer is an external OKF-format bundle maintained outside this repository.
memory.fallback: Without a memory tool the session relies on the five records and HANDOFF; no external memory write without an explicit request.

todo-list.mechanism: TodoWrite or the session task tools for the run's own checklist.
todo-list.fallback: The run checklist is kept in the assignment text and the run-state history.

goal.mechanism: TASKS.md current task and HANDOFF next action carry the persistent goal across turns and sessions.
goal.fallback: Without the records the goal is restated from the approved specification at each entry.

code-map-build.mechanism: doxygen Doxyfile in the target via Bash; XML output read back for entity associations.
code-map-build.fallback: Missing doxygen or Doxyfile is owed bootstrap work and reported, never an exemption; only an explicit written host prohibition is NOT_APPLICABLE.

check-runner.mechanism: Bash runs the target's declared test, lint, map and probe commands with complete streams and exit codes retained.
check-runner.fallback: An unavailable command leaves its criterion BLOCKED with the reason.

run-record-access.mechanism: The run-state ledger (run_state.py show), Workflow journals, session transcripts in the user-level Claude projects directory and the target's notes, read-only.
run-record-access.fallback: Missing records are reported as missing; no reconstruction presented as fact.

packaging-install.mechanism: claude --plugin-dir <repo>/implementations/claude for one session, CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS set to that path in the user settings env for every session, or a local directory marketplace whose root contains the package, loads the package in place; claude plugin validate --strict checks it.
packaging-install.fallback: Copied installs (git marketplace, cache) are unsupported: the SessionStart hook reports the missing neutral binding as BLOCKED and dependent work stops. A symlinked skills-directory plugin is unsupported too: its neutral references miss although the hook reports it bound.

launch-environment.mechanism: The session working directory, added directories, the owner's permission mode and environment define roots and autonomy; credentials follow policies/credentials.md.
launch-environment.fallback: Unknown roots or permissions are discovered and stated before effects; no settings change.

capability-discovery.mechanism: The session's tool list and deferred-tool search, the registered agent types, and claude plugin details for the package inventory.
capability-discovery.fallback: An undiscoverable capability is treated as absent and its fallback applies.

context-management.mechanism: Automatic compaction, subagents for context isolation, and the SessionStart hook on compact re-orienting from the records.
context-management.fallback: HANDOFF and the run-state ledger restore the state after a lost context.

tracker-integration.mechanism: An issue-tracker connector only on an explicit owner request for that project.
